# `uses` lists: the interface keeps a declaration's bare list and writes the
# type's list in parentheses; type-of answers print types the same way.
> interface app/main
export function* lines(): Generator<string> uses (io, alloc)
export function read(source: () => int uses (io, alloc)): int uses io, alloc
export function run(_args: Array<string>): int
> type-of src/main.nra:11:9
Generator<string> uses (alloc, io)
> type-of src/main.nra:11:15
() => Generator<string> uses (io, alloc) uses alloc
> type-of src/main.nra:7:10
() => int uses (io, alloc)
